title: Transcriptomic Profiling of Neighborhood Deprivation in Oropharyngeal Squamous Cell Carcinoma: An Exploratory Pilot Study.
snippet: To conduct an exploratory pilot study evaluating the differential peripheral blood gene expression profiles and clinical and sociodemographic characteristics of oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma survivors, explore how neighborhood disadvantage shapes gene expression, and analyze the biologic embedding of structural inequities. 23 oropharyngeal squamous....
